t: I heard the child cry, and I thanked the god before anyone spoke.
Both survived. Maybe skill saved them, and maybe the god helped.
I watched people work for that safe birth. They deserve the credit.
They say the god guarded the birth. Mother and child are safe.
I heard both are well. Perhaps somebody was listening after all.
The birth went well because capable people were there. That is good enough.
Word reached us about a safe birth. I do not know the family.
I watched the field thicken before my eyes. The god made it answer.
The plants came on too quickly for weather alone. I think I saw providence.
The field looked fuller, but good growth can surprise anyone.
They say the god filled the land with new growth.
I heard the fields changed in a moment. I am trying to believe it.
People saw a good field and built a miracle around it.
The story says whole fields grew heavy farther down the valley.
I saw someone strike the ground hard. The god put them there.
They hit the ground beside me. I cannot explain how they fell.
I saw the landing, not the cause. People are adding that part.
They say the god drove someone into the ground.
I heard someone fell hard after something strange. The cause is unclear.
A hard fall became divine judgment before the dust settled.
The story reached me as a person falling from nowhere.
I felt the impact through my boots. They did not simply trip.
They came down shoulder first. Everyone nearby heard it.
I saw dust jump when they landed. Somebody ran for the healer.
They hit hard enough to leave a mark in the ground.
I heard the crash before I saw the person on the ground.
Someone struck the earth hard, from what the nearest witnesses say.
I watched the god lift a person clear of the ground.
Their feet rose above my head. I think the god was there.
I saw them leave the ground, but I will not invent a reason.
They say the god raised someone where the whole square could see.
I heard a person floated above the road. I barely believe myself repeating it.
The story has somebody flying now. It probably began with a stumble.
Farther on, people claim a person rose without rope or ladder.
I saw the wolf tear into them, and the god kept them alive.
The wolf had them down. Maybe something heard us shouting.
I watched a hungry wolf attack. Nothing supernatural was needed.
They say the god spared someone from a wolf's teeth.
I heard the attack was terrible. I hope somebody watched over them.
People are blaming signs and omens. The wolf was simply hungry.
Word from the far road says a wolf badly hurt someone.
I watched the damage close under the god's hand.
What was broken became whole. I think I saw a miracle.
I saw the repair afterwards, not who performed it.
They say the god repaired what no worker could fix.
I heard the break vanished without tools. That is difficult to dismiss.
Someone repaired it quietly, and now everyone wants a miracle.
The tale from farther out says broken work made itself whole.
I was there when they died. The god received them.
I watched their breathing stop. I hope someone waited beyond it.
I saw a life end. I will not claim knowledge past that.
They say the god called someone away last night.
I heard they died quietly. I want to believe they were not alone.
Someone died, and people are already pretending to know why.
News of a death reached us from the other side of town.
I saw the food arrive with nobody bringing it. The god provided.
The baskets appeared beside us. I think a prayer was answered.
I saw food where none had been. I did not see who brought it.
They say the god filled empty hands with food.
I heard food appeared near the stores. The timing makes me wonder.
Somebody misplaced a basket, and now the story calls it providence.
Farther along, they say food arrived from nowhere.
I watched an empty patch fill with provisions. Nobody walked near it.
Food was suddenly there, plain as the ground under it.
I counted the sacks before and after. More stood there afterwards.
The meal arrived before anyone could fetch it. I was standing close.
I saw full baskets where the ground had been bare.
Nobody brought that food through the square. I watched every path.
There was nothing, then enough to eat. That is exactly what I saw.
I touched the food myself. It was real and still nobody claimed it.
The story around town is that food appeared beside the hungry.
Three people told me the same thing: nobody brought those baskets.
I keep hearing about food set down without anyone bringing it.
The tale has reached the road now. Somewhere, empty stores filled themselves.
I felt the god move the earth under my feet.
The ground rolled while I stood there. I nearly called it divine.
I felt an earthquake. Fear supplied the god afterwards.
They say the god shook every wall in the village.
I heard the ground moved like water. That is hard to hear calmly.
There was a quake, and people immediately gave it intentions.
The shaking was felt well beyond the village, from what reached me.
I watched the god lower a person safely to the ground.
They came down gently in front of me. I cannot explain it.
I saw them land safely. The rest of the story is guesswork.
They say the god returned someone gently to the earth.
I heard a person floated down unharmed. I do not know what to believe.
A safe landing became divine mercy by the third telling.
The distant version says a person was lowered without rope.
I saw the god strike a person under a clear sky.
The bolt came from nowhere. I fear it may have been judgment.
I saw lightning kill someone. I did not see a judge.
They say the god struck someone before the whole square.
I heard the sky was clear when the lightning came. That troubles me.
Lightning killed someone, and fear turned weather into judgment.
The far story says a person was struck beneath a clear sky.
I watched the god throw a person across the ground.
They flew farther than any fall should send them. I think the god acted.
I saw the person tumble. The story makes the distance larger.
They say the god flung someone clear across the square.
I heard a person was thrown without anyone touching them.
Every retelling throws them farther. I doubt the first distance too.
The version that reached me has a person flying over rooftops.
I watched the god pull a tree out by every root.
The whole tree came free at once. I nearly called it a sign.
I saw a tree fall with rotten roots. People preferred a miracle.
They say the god tore a tree from sound ground.
I heard the roots came out clean. That detail makes me wonder.
A fallen tree became an uprooted wonder as the story travelled.
Farther up the road, they claim whole trees leave the ground.
